subject: Cargo inquiry — 18,000 MT steel, loading Mariupol (UA)
body:
Dear Sirs,

We are looking for suitable vessel for the following cargo:

CARGO: Steel slabs
QUANTITY: 18,000 MT
LOADING PORT: Mariupol, Ukraine (UAMRP)
DISCHARGE PORT: Constanta (RO)
LAYCAN: 18–22 April 2026

Freight: USD 28/MT FIOS
Loadrate: 3,000 MT/day PWWD SHINC
Discharge: 3,000 MT/day PWWD SHINC
Demurrage: USD 3,000/day

Please note loading port is Mariupol — vessel must hold valid P&I and flag-state approval for this port.

Kindly advise availability.

Best regards,
Chartering
Azov Trade & Shipping
